This '''Police droid''' was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|Guardian police droid]] and a [[Unidentified Guardian police droid 2|fellow]] one were on patrol one night on the streets of Coruscant when they heard a scream coming from a nearby alley. They then rushed towards the location of the sound only to find [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] attacked by two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]]. The droids told the bounty hunters they were under arrest, allowing Padmé Amidala enough time to get away from them. The bounty hunters did not surrender and started to attack the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], destroying them.

==Behind the scenes==
This police droid was voiced by actor [[Tom Kane]].
